2.1.3.0.fixed: Bug where Start Event At Object could cause an audio glitch

2.1.3.1.changed: Moved to non debug version of the library

2.1.3.2.fixed: Should no longer crash on older versions of C3

2.1.3.3.fixed: Fixed a bug that could cause naming conflicts on the domside

2.2.0.0.added: - Debug property: switches to FMOD's logging build (fmodstudioL) at runtime, no separate addon needed
2.2.0.0.changed:
- FMOD now runs in a dedicated web worker. Mixing no longer depends on the main thread, so lag spikes, debugger pauses and other freezes in the game no longer stutter audio playback
- Studio update runs on the worker's own clock instead of the runtime tick
- Updated to FMOD 2.03.14
- Both the release and logging libraries ship in the addon; only the selected one is loaded
2.2.0.0.fixed:
- Unload Bank / Unload All Banks never completed (the bank handle is invalid as soon as FMOD unloads it, and the plugin kept polling it)
- Stopping an event with release did not actually release the FMOD instance, so instances piled up over time
- Node environment detection fix is now applied to the release library too (fixes crashes on NW.js-style hosts)

2.2.0.1.fixed: Library, wasm and banks are now fetched by the page and handed to the worker; the worker's own requests aren't served in Construct's preview, so 2.2.0.0 failed to load there

2.2.1.0.added: Sends an "event-stopped" message to the runtime whenever an event instance stops (used by the FMOD plugin's On Event Stopped triggers)
2.2.1.0.changed: Instances released while still playing (one-shots, stop with fade out) are now released once they have stopped, so FMOD reports the stop

2.2.1.1.fixed:
Start Event now starts the instances created by Instantiate Event with the same tags (and not started yet) instead of always creating a new one, so parameters and 3D attributes set between the two actually apply. Instances already playing are never touched; without Instantiate Event nothing changes.

This was a regression from the port to V2
